now.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S4#3
now.text: Jemma Simmons works with Holden Radcliffe to save Melinda May's life, killing and reviving her.
now.on_a_card_about_b: Scientist who works with Radcliffe to save May.
now.on_b_card_about_a: Scientist Jemma works with to save May.

proposed.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S4#11
proposed.text: Fitz learns Radcliffe is behind Aida's attack, and Jemma joins the team that arrests him at his home. The man they take turns out to be his android double.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Scientist who works with Radcliffe to save May, then helps arrest him.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Scientist Jemma works with to save May, until he turns on S.H.I.E.L.D.

changes.evidence: In 'Wake Up' (S4#11) Fitz finds that Radcliffe caused Aida's malfunction and Simmons joins Coulson's team to arrest Radcliffe at his residence; the arrested man is his LMD, whom she then interrogates. The ally-to-enemy turn happens here, six episodes before the next stage (S4#17).

now.title: Spider-Man (1994)#46
now.text: Alistair goes to work for Silvermane.
now.on_b_card_about_a: The hero Alistair blames for his father's loss.

proposed.text: Now Silvermane's top scientist, Alistair kidnaps the Black Cat and forces Spider-Man to bring him the DNA of the Scorpion or the Vulture to win her release.

changes.evidence: In 'Partners' (episode 46), Alistair, working as Silvermane's top scientist, kidnaps the Black Cat and blackmails Spider-Man into capturing the Scorpion or the Vulture for their DNA in exchange for her release. The current text only says he goes to work for Silvermane and leaves out what happens between him and Peter.

owner_calls.question: Should Ward and Lorelei stay 'partner'? Their only link is a one-episode enchantment: she makes him her enthralled slave (and they share a room in Las Vegas) until Sif captures her. Before the spell, Ward was trying to arrest her.
owner_calls.evidence: Yes Men (S1#15): Ward holds Lorelei at gunpoint and orders her to surrender, then she enthralls him and makes him her loyal slave. They go to Las Vegas and sleep at Caesars Palace, and he turns on the team until Sif takes her back. Under the brief's rule, a brief fling doesn't make partners.

owner_calls.question: The first stage is at S4#3, but Jemma and Radcliffe first meet in S3#18 ('The Singularity'), when she and Fitz try to recruit him in Bucharest, and they work together against Hive in the two-part S3 finale (S3#21-22). Add an earlier stage?
options: Add a stage at Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3#18 (they meet in Bucharest; Hive takes him)
Add a stage at the S3 finale (they work together against Hive)
owner_calls.evidence: Radcliffe tests Fitz and Simmons in Bucharest (The Singularity). Later he works with Simmons at the Playground against Hive's Primitives, and afterwards with FitzSimmons on his research.
